claims: Rory McIlroy won his second consecutive Masters title on Sunday, April 12, 2026.
Rory McIlroy finished 12-under par in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy defeated Scottie Scheffler by one stroke in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler was the runner-up in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The final day of the 2026 Masters Tournament was Sunday, April 12, 2026.
The 2026 Masters Tournament was held at Augusta National Golf Club.
Rory McIlroy's victory makes him just the fourth golfer in history to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
